sources.entry: Roundtable - Zero-configuration MCP server that unifies multiple AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) through intelligent auto-discovery.

summary.one_liner: Roundtable AI is a local MCP server that lets a primary IDE assistant delegate tasks in parallel to sub-agent CLIs such as Gemini, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, and returns one synthesized response.
keywords: use multiple ai tools in ide
use_cases: Delegating analysis of logs or codebases to several AI models at once from an IDE
Debugging a production issue across frontend and backend with multiple agents
Parallel performance review of slow queries and hot code paths
Getting Gemini, Claude and Codex opinions in one synthesized answer
Running the same coding assistant tools from Claude Code, Cursor or other MCP clients
how_to_run: claude mcp add roundtable-ai -- roundtable-ai --agents gemini,claude,codex,cursor
notable: Runs sub-agent CLIs in parallel and synthesizes their responses into one result
Uses existing CLI tools and API subscriptions with no markup, per the README
Configurable per-IDE via CLI_MCP_SUBAGENTS environment variable or --agents flag
Exposes availability check and execute tools for each supported agent
Claims support for 26+ MCP-compatible clients, with setup snippets for the top seven
caveats: Requires the underlying CLI tools (Gemini, Claude, Codex, Cursor) to be installed and configured separately
npx @roundtable/mcp-server is listed as coming soon, not yet available
Each sub-agent call uses the user's own API keys or subscriptions, so costs follow those tools
